entries.note: The first row of every resi, recorded by the counter account of the branch or drop point that books, weighs and prices the parcel; the town follows after a dash.

entries.wording: Paket dalam perjalanan dari gudang asal
entries.note: The origin city follows after a dash.

entries.wording: Paket telah sampai di gudang transit
entries.note: The transit city follows after a dash.

entries.wording: Paket telah berangkat dari gudang transit

entries.note: The destination branch follows after a dash; the parcel reached the destination warehouse, not the recipient.
The courier's name follows after a dash.

Scheduled delivery: a note after the dash books the delivery on a later run, such as one between islands, with a reason in brackets. Seen a minute after the courier took the parcel, with no attempt; the delivery followed.

entries.wording: Alamat Tidak Ditemukan / Penerima Tidak Dapat Di Hubungi
entries.note: Address not found or recipient unreachable; a name and relation follow after a dash. Seen repeated a second apart, then followed by the delivery.
The receiver's name and relation follow after a dash.
